title: A$AP Rocky’s New Ray-Ban Collection Features Elevated Puffy Eyewear Styles at Affordable Pricing
summary: The collection features silhouettes made for the statement-maker with both colorful and neutral options.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

After being named Ray-Ban’s first-ever creative director in early 2025, A$AP Rocky has hit the ground running, launching banger collection after banger collection.

When Rocky isn’t busy cooking up beats or turning looks with his boo, Rihanna, the creative is putting in work designing frames that Ray-Ban shoppers have never seen before. The “Fashion Killa” rapper’s latest line, called the “Puffer Evolution,” is just as good as his last, and more affordable too, with pricing starting at $202. The focus of this eyewear launch is reimagining the brand’s Aviator, Flacko and Kiliane silhouettes. Every style can be shopped on Ray-Ban’s website .

A$AP Rocky x Ray-Ban Puffer Evolution Line

A$AP Rocky x Ray-Ban Flacko Puffer

$202

Buy Now at ray-ban

This style is inspired by Rocky’s nickname/alter-ego, Pretty Flacko. While the word means skinny in Spanish, these sunglasses are rather chunky and super stylish.

Ray-Ban Wayfarer Puffer Crystal Edition

$292

Black sunnies with crystalized logos.

Bold and rockeresque, we aren’t able to pass up on these Flacko frames for $202. This is a style we gravitated toward because they are unlike any black sunglasses we’ve seen before. This is because of those puffy frames that give this model a stylish chunky quality. Gold accents can be seen throughout the eyewear, juxtaposing the all-black color scheme.

The Flacko has a strong brow bar, or the portion of the frames that connect the lenses together in the center. This is reminiscent of an aviator style, which is a detail we enjoy. You’ll likely buy hundreds of black sunglasses in your lifetime that all virtually look the same, but if you want to diversify your eyewear collection without going too crazy, this is the pair to get. Plus, compared to Rocky’s last launch with Ray-Ban, with pricing up to $7,000, the Flacko model is very affordable.

A$AP Rocky x Ray-Ban Kiliane Puffer

The Kiliane silhouette comes in four total colorways. The all-white model has to be our second favorite if you’re looking for something maximalist in this same style.

The Kiliane is also $202, like the Flacko, but is much slimmer. These frames are reminiscent of models worn in the 90s , sleek and uncomplicated. For a change-up from the usual all-black, we’ve chosen these chocolate brown shades with coordinating tinted lenses.

You have those puffy frames, a signature of Rocky’s line with Ray-Ban. The Kiliane is another cool style that you can get a ton of use out of, since brown is a neutral that goes with almost everything. You’ll be adding something different to your collection, since most people already have black sunglasses in their rotation.

These are sunglasses that, if treated with care, will last you a lifetime. If you do happen to crack the lens or break the frame, Ray-Ban has a repair service to make them new again. And, if your eyewear is still under warranty, you can get it fixed free of charge. Learn more here .

A$AP Rocky x Ray-Ban Wayfarer Puffer Special Collection

$229

The Wayfarer was the fixture of Rocky’s last collaboration with Ray-Ban. This special collection includes five unique colorways.

The Wayfarer is a signature Ray-Ban style and one of the brand’s bestsellers. First designed in 1952 , the eyewear has gone through many changes. Ray-Ban’s golden child has been spotted on some pretty famous faces in the past, including James Dean, Andy Warhol and John F. Kennedy.

In the hands of Rocky, these frames have now received a colorful reimagining in vibrant hues like this green style with blue lenses. The special collection model retails for $229 and is more of a maximalist offering. Green is a welcome change from all the black and brown sunglasses of the world. If you’re seeking something bold for the summertime, you’ll find a myriad of options in the rapper’s Wayfarer Puffer Special Collection.

A$AP Rocky x Ray Ban Puffer Collection

Instead of the thin frame the Wayfarer is well known for, these Rocky models have been exaggerated, made blocky with sculptural curves and high-octane finishes, hence the “puffer” title. It’s safe to say that these are statement-makers, meant for those who aren’t afraid to draw attention.

A$AP Rocky x Ray-Ban Wayfarer Puffer Diamond Edition

$7,000

Black sunglasses with diamonds and 14K gold finishings.

There’s nothing sexier than black sunglasses, unless, of course, they’re encrusted with diamonds. Finally, we have the Diamond edition, which retails for $7,000 . Don’t let the subdued silhouette fool you. These sunglasses are absolutely dripping in gold and diamonds, hence the price tag. The glasses are affixed with handset diamonds and 14K gold finishings that contrast the black frames nicely. This is an investment piece for sure, but one we’d recommend getting if you want your black sunglasses to have a little more oomph than your standard style.

Beyond being an accomplished musician and Billboard chart regular, Rocky has made a name for himself in the fashion landscape. It’s no wonder Ray-Ban bestowed him with a creative director title. The star’s first collection with the brand was titled Blacked Out Collection, a sort of test drive of his new role, which included oversized silhouettes, gold accents and ultra-dark lenses.
